# ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com

> ExcavationTrenchingShoring.com offers self-paced online OSHA training covering every role on an excavation job site: the 3-hour Excavation, Trenching & Shoring Safety Training for crew-level hazard awareness, and the 8-hour Competent Person for Excavation, Trenching & Shoring course for daily inspections, protective system selection, and program oversight. Both courses are available in English and Spanish, are mobile-friendly, and issue a certificate of completion immediately. Courses are aligned with OSHA's excavation standard, 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P.

Excavation Trenching Shoring Training is a subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC, and partners with HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC. Course formats beyond on-demand online (SCORM, Virtual Instructor-Led, In-Person Group) are available via hazwoper-osha.com.

## Courses

- [Excavation, Trenching & Shoring Safety Training](https://www.excavationtrenchingshoring.com/#pricing): 3 hours, $59.99/seat. Crew-level hazard-awareness course for excavation and trenching crews, equipment operators, and utility/municipal staff — recognizing cave-in, atmospheric, and utility-strike hazards; soil classification and protective system basics; safe access, egress, and spoil pile placement; and when to stop work and notify the Competent Person.
- [Competent Person for Excavation, Trenching & Shoring Training](https://www.excavationtrenchingshoring.com/#pricing): 8 hours, $159.99/seat. Program-oversight course for safety managers, foremen, and EHS coordinators — defining the Competent Person role and authority, soil classification (Stable Rock, Type A, Type B, Type C), selecting protective systems (sloping, benching, shielding, shoring), daily inspection duties, and building a written excavation safety program and emergency plan.

## Resources

- [Excavation, Trenching & Shoring FAQ](https://www.excavationtrenchingshoring.com/frequently-asked-questions/): 30+ answers covering excavation basics, OSHA Subpart P regulations and legal requirements, soil and protective systems, site safety practices (spoil placement, access/egress, atmospheric testing, water accumulation), Competent Person duties, and course/certification details (general guidance only, not legal advice).

- [HAZWOPER-OSHA.com — Competent Person listing](https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/competent-person-for-excavation-trenching-and-shoring): SCORM, Virtual Instructor-Led, and In-Person Group options.
- [Industrial Certified Training, LLC](https://ictraining.us/): Parent company, specializing in OSHA, EPA, and IACET-accredited training.
